1.mascotDialogue: It's insertion sort, güey, given permission to take big steps first! Shrink the gap enough times, it collapses into ordinary insertion sort for the final, finest pass.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 2's gap starts at n over 2 and halves every outer pass. Lines 6 through 8 are just insertion sort's inner loop, comparing arr[j] to arr[j minus gap] instead of arr[j minus 1].

3.mascotDialogue: Watch these first comparisons skip across three positions at once — that's a gap of 3, making long-distance corrections before the finer gap-of-1 pass even starts!

4.mascotDialogue: A subtle kind of bug, this — the output's correct, but the algorithm's quietly stopped being the algorithm it claims to be. Not every bug crashes — some just throw away the whole reason you picked this approach.
